scheduler_catch_up_recovery.root_cause: When all runtime routes were temporarily unavailable at dispatch time, the scheduler created a terminal skipped run and advanced next_run_at. A route recovery after host resume could not dispatch that missed trigger.
scheduler_catch_up_recovery.repair: Keep the planned instant without creating a run while the selected runtime provider is temporarily unreachable; dispatch it once the route recovers. Preserve static route/configuration skip behavior and coalesce multiple missed instants to the latest one.
